answer: Delayed-seed slot lottery. Registrants pay a non-refundable fee and post a proof-of-work during a sealed window. The seed appears only after that window closes — a threshold-BLS beacon from a public nebula of independent contributors — so the draw cannot be precomputed. Hashing each key against the seed ranks registrants; the top 5% win a pearl, the right to submit work. Commitments stay velvet, so a farm cannot see which keys survive. Losers forfeit their fee, so each usable sybil costs about twenty registrations: 20× fee and 20× computation.
